name: Rod of Ages
description:

Timeless
After 2 combat rounds, this item gains an additional 50 Ability Power, 300 Health, and 400 Mana, and you gain a level.

Eternity
Taking damage from champions restores 7% of premitigation damage as Mana. Casting an ability heals for 25% of Mana spent, up to 20 Health per cast, per second.
